name: Self Delusion
overview: Scripture reveals self delusion as a dangerous mindset where individuals falsely assure themselves of peace and security despite living in sin, as seen in Deuteronomy 29:19 where one blesses himself in his heart while walking in the imagination of his own heart. This is further exemplified in Psalms 10:6 and 30:6, where the wicked confidently declare they will never face adversity or be moved in prosperity. Additionally, Psalms 10:11 highlights the delusion of believing God has forgotten and will not punish sin. The example of Ahab in 1 Kings 20 illustrates how such self-deception leads to fatal consequences, underscoring the peril of trusting in one's own understanding rather than God's truth.
